# Aquila and Priscilla (Acts 18:26)

## Emotional Focus
Husband and wife friends working together for God.

## Key KJV
“And they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly.” (Acts 18:26)

## Gentle Retelling
Aquila and Priscilla were tent-makers and friends to Paul. They worked together, opened their home, and kindly taught others about Jesus.

## Coloring Prompt
Aquila and Priscilla sewing a tent together while talking happily.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Friends who love Jesus can help each other grow.”
